candidate: Zhongwei (Ningxia) West Cloud Base and Xuanhe campus locators: China Unicom Zhongwei Cloud Data Center (DC9), China Mobile (Ningxia Zhongwei) Data Center B-zone (B07) and Xuanhe campus (D07-D10)
method: Each selected point is the station-centre coordinate of an on-campus 110 kV substation printed in geographic degrees-minutes-seconds in an official environmental impact report published by the Zhongwei Ecology and Environment Bureau, transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees (deg + min/60 + sec/3600) with no datum transformation. The reports name no datum. Precedent: the China Telecom Shaotang substation locator (official_eia_on_campus_substation_locator).

synthesis_check: The synthesis re-extracted each printed coordinate from the hashed PDF captures with pdftotext and recomputed the decimal values; all agree to the stated precision.
registration_check: Qualitative only: with the printed values read directly as WGS84 longitude/latitude, the cloud-base EIA points fall on the expected parcels of the road grid north and south of Fengyun Road in Esri World Imagery and EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2025 (the CIDC point on the built CIDC campus, the Unicom points inside the built Unicom block); none shows the several-hundred-metre systematic offset a GCJ-02 web-map coordinate would produce. The Xuanhe point was matched against the report's own satellite figure and Esri imagery. This is not a measured accuracy.
